_about: The public speech datasets dictation's benchmark (dict.md section 8, B-1) can use. Read by scripts/fetch_bench_audio.py and scripts/dictbench.py --dataset. Nothing here is ever committed as audio: every set is downloaded on demand, by a person, into a cache outside the repository. A null sha256 means the archive has not been pinned yet: the first person to fetch it runs fetch_bench_audio.py --pin, checks the result, and commits the hash. Licence entries copy dict.md section 8's dataset table (checked 2026-10-13); licence_verified false means the source was secondary or silent.

datasets.name: LibriVox held-out set, English (B-1a)
datasets.licence: Public domain (LibriVox recordings, definitely in the USA); book text from Project Gutenberg with the licence and every reference to Project Gutenberg stripped
datasets.attribution: Recorded by LibriVox volunteers; the reader and book of every segment are listed in the subset's ATTRIBUTION.txt
datasets.contamination: low for recordings catalogued after a model's cutoff
datasets.notes: Built by scripts/bench_librivox.py. Published as a pinned, SHA-256-verified asset on the assets-v1 release once built and reviewed; until then, build it locally.

datasets.contamination: low, but offered to companies for training (unverified)
datasets.notes: Apply for the data use agreement (dict.md B-1d asks for this in parallel).

datasets.name: Volunteer real-dictation set (B-1d)

datasets.notes: Later phase. Kept outside the repository; register the folder with --local.

model_cutoffs._about: The upper-bound date of each model's training data, for B-1a's held-out rule: a LibriVox recording is held out for a model only if it was catalogued after this date. None is published; each is the safe assumption dict.md section 8 names. null means no date is known yet, so nothing counts as held out for that model until one is filled in.

whisper.basis: assumption: a safe upper bound for large-v3-turbo; Whisper's own cutoff is unpublished
